title: EFFECTIVENESS OF SUPPLEMENTATION WITH VITAMIN D IN PATIENTS WITH DEPRESSIVE DISORDER OR BIPOLAR DISORDER: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED CLINICAL TRIAL
official: EFFECTIVENESS OF SUPPLEMENTATION WITH VITAMIN D IN PATIENTS WITH DEPRESSIVE DISORDER OR BIPOLAR DISORDER: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED CLINICAL TRIAL
summary: Main objective: Evaluation of the effect of cholecalciferol treatment in subjects with depressive disorder or bipolar disorder after 12 weeks.

interventions.name: Olive oil, refined vehicle 2,5 ml (quality standard Ph. Eur. current edition monograph 1456)
DIBASE 50.000 U.I./2,5 ml soluzione orale in contenitore monodose

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age 18-75 years
2. Subjects referred to  the Psychiatry Unit of the Entity at the Azienda Ospedaliera Universitario Senese with a diagnosis of major depressive disorder or disorder bipolar
3. MADRS score >15
4. Serum level of 25(OH) Vitamin D< 20 ng/ml
5. Stable antipsycothic therapy (at least two weeks)
6. Patients able to take Vitamin D supplementation (oral formulation)
7. Willingness to provide free and informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Osteoporosis or previous fragility fractures
2. Drug abuse
3. Therapy with calcifediol, calcitriol, cholecalciferol or calcium supplementation in progress or in the previous two months
4. Neoplastic disease or severe liver, kidney or gastrointestinal disease
5. Severe cognitive impairment
6. Acute psychosis
7. Inability to answer questions
8. Refusal to sign informed consent
9. Osteomalacia or Paget's disease
10. Diseases known to have interference with vitamin D metabolism (sarcoidosis, hypercalcemia, renal failure)
11. Pregnancy or lactation
12. Secondary osteoporosis (primary or secondary hyperparathyroidism, hyperprolactinemia, etc.)
13. Therapy with estrogens, drugs for osteoporosis, or drugs known to have interference with bone metabolism (antiepileptics, cortisone, antiretrovirals, heparin etc.)
14. Diabetes mellitus types 1 and 2
15. Lipid metabolism disorders
16. Body Mass Index of less than 18 or more than 34.9 kg/sqm
